Title: Visit from the Capuchin VS SteelyTenacity

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

I have Visit from the Capuchin in play
I play Steely Tenacity.
At the end of the action, may I get back the action card instead of burning a token from the master card?
I am almost sure that I can but I would thank any confirmation.

By the waym I have another doubt about that action card.
If it is cancelled by Direct Intervention for instance, can I get back to my hand by its own card text?

Card text
Name: Steely Tenacity
Cardtype: Action/Combat
Requires an anarch. Do not replace until after this action. When you would replace this card, you may take this card from your ash heap instead.

Name: Visit from the Capuchin
Cardtype: Master
Put this card into play with 4 counters on it. You get +X hand size, where X is the number of counters on this card. Each time you would draw to replace a card (not counting the card to replace the Visit), burn a counter from this card instead. Burn this card if it has no counters.

Thanks in advance.
Regards,
Rémi.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Rémi wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> I have Visit from the Capuchin in play
> I play Steely Tenacity.
> At the end of the action, may I get back the action card instead of burning a token from the master card?
>
"When you would replace this card, you may take this card from your ash heap instead."
If you choose this option, you don't remove a counter from the Visit.
Otherwise, you would draw to replace the card, but then the Visit would prevent you from drawing and would remove a counter from itself instead.

> Rémi wrote:
> If it is cancelled by Direct Intervention for instance, can I get back to my hand by its own card text?
>
No, because the card is cancelled and has no effect.
